messages.subject: Function to start with fresh workspace
messages.subject_clean: Function to start with fresh workspace
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I wanted to propose an idea for a function to start with a clean workspace.

This is something that I like to do when I'm testing scripts / package development to make sure that I have not inadvertently attached a library and unintentionally created a dependency.

I do something like this at the start of my scripts

source('DetachNonStandardPackages.R')  ## actually I do library('my_private_library')
DetachNonStandardPackages()
rm(list=ls())

library('package1')
library('package2')
library('package3')
## etc...

Here's what the function looks like:
DetachNonStandardPackages = function(
    standard_packages = c('rstudio', 'stats', 'graphics', 'grDevices', 'utils',
                          'datasets', 'methods', 'base'),
    special_packages = NULL
    ){

    ## Some packages, like DTW can only be loaded once per R session,
    ## don't detach those
    #special_packages = c('dtw', 'proxy')
    attached_packages = .packages()
cat('\nDetaching non-standard libraries:\n')
for(pkg in attached_packages){
if(! (pkg %in% standard_packages || pkg %in% special_packages) ){
cat('Detaching:', pkg, '\n')
detach(paste('package:', pkg, sep=''), character.only=TRUE)
}
}
}
